title: finance.compliance.eway_bill.retry_scheduled
description: The e-Way portal did not answer (an outage, a timeout, a 5xx or a rate limit) and the same consignment will be sent again at retry_at, under the same idempotency key, so a retry cannot produce a second bill. The goods are already loaded, which is why this is announced: somebody may want to ring the driver. error is the portal's own text with GSTINs, vehicle numbers and other identifiers masked. A terminal outcome is finance.compliance.eway_bill.failed instead.
